$comment: Dated aliases of sf-popover for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (attribute rows), manifest-only (the DOM name does not change; its meaning does, so no shim).

aliases.note: read by the popover, not the shim: role leaves the host once read (the shim would mirror that removal onto surface-role); each read is noted with these dates
the same DOM name is the cancelable request now (sent before opening); the fact is sf-popover-opened
the same DOM name is the cancelable request now (sent before closing, {reason, unsaved}); the fact is sf-popover-closed
